copy.tagline: 用SQL做产品数据分析，处理日历交叉、日期边界等复杂逻辑
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用SQL分析用户行为数据
copy.tagline_en: Analyze product data with SQL, handling calendar cross-joins and date boundaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently analyze user behavior data with SQL

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在聚合事件数据时，会从事实表（如events）驱动而非用户维度表；执行日历交叉连接时自动限制在今天的日期内；将不同事件类型展开为独立的计数列；首次构建时滚动窗口指标返回 NULL 而非 0。
howto.when: 当涉及事件指标聚合、每日模型包含日历交叉连接、事件表有类型列需透视统计，或构建增量模型首次运行时触发。

say.text: 统计过去7天各事件的每日发生次数，按类型分列
say.note: 触发日历交叉连接和事件类型透视。

say.text: 计算每个用户的首次激活日期后的30天滚动活跃天数
say.note: 触发首次运行行为规则。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude drives event aggregation from fact tables (e.g., events) rather than dimension tables; automatically caps calendar cross-joins at today's date; pivots distinct event types into separate count columns; returns NULL instead of 0 for rolling window metrics on first build.
howto.when_en: Triggered when aggregating event metrics, when daily models involve calendar cross-joins, when events table has type column for pivoting, or when building incremental models for the first time.

say_en.text: Count daily occurrences of each event type for the last 7 days
say_en.note: Triggers calendar spine cross-join and event type pivoting.

say_en.text: Compute 30-day rolling active days after each user's first activation date
